description: This file provides class templates for InlineDeviceGuard and InlineOptionalDeviceGuard, which manage device context switching using RAII in the PyTorch codebase. It includes class definitions, methods for setting and resetting devices, and documentation comments.

classes.name: InlineDeviceGuard
classes.description: A templated RAII class that manages setting and restoring a device context, supporting both concrete and virtual implementations.

classes.name: InlineOptionalDeviceGuard
classes.description: A templated RAII class that manages optional device context switching, allowing for uninitialized state and safe device management.

methods.name: set_device
methods.description: Sets the device to the specified device, with specialization based on whether the implementation is virtual or concrete.

methods.name: reset_device
methods.description: Resets the device to the original device, with specialization for virtual implementations.

methods.name: set_index
methods.description: Sets the device index, inferring device type from the original device.

methods.name: original_device
methods.description: Returns the device at the time of guard creation.

methods.name: current_device
methods.description: Returns the most recent device set by the guard.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the optional device guard to an uninitialized state.
